Timeline

[edit]
  • 2017
  • 2018
  • 2019
  • 2020
  • Show All
  • October 21st - Valiance acquire Binary Dragons' Global Offensive team. [1]
  • March 1st - soLo leaves Valiance. [2]
  • March 12th - Impulse replaces DJOXiC. [3]
  • June 13th - Valiance add kassad as coach. [4]
  • August 14th - Valiance replace NENO with jayzaR. [5]
  • October 8th - kassad is re-signed by Renegades as their coach. [6]
  • November 3rd - Valiance sign nexa, EspiranTo and ottoNd, bench jayzaR and Impulse, finally emi moves to an analyst position. [7]
  • November 14th - jayzaR announced that his contract with the organization had ended. [8]
  • January 1st - Impulse's contract expires. [9]
  • February 7th - DJOXiC is acquired by Entity Gaming. [10]
  • June 9th - Valiance & Co rebrand as CR4ZY. [11]
  • September 30th - nexa and huNter- are acquired by G2 Esports. [12]
  • October 4th - CR4ZY sign SHiPZ, emi returns to the active roster and NeiL_M joins as the team's coach. [13]
  • January 20th - CR4ZY's lineup is acquired by c0ntact Gaming. [14]
  • February 18th - CR4ZY sign Project X, a squad consisting of dERZKIY, dOBRIY, Sergiz, Psycho, SENSEi and Johnta - the latter as the team's coach. [15]
  • April 16th - CR4ZY bench dERZKIY and dOBRIY; they sign DemQQ and 7oX1C as replacements. [16]
  • May 18th - dERZKIY joins Moscow Five Academy as a stand-in. [17]
  • May 21st - dOBRIY and dERZKIY are released from their contracts; they leave CR4ZY as a result. [18][19]
  • September 30th - CR4ZY release their team. [20]
